theorem stateHistoryEquiv_survival_iff
    {X : Type u} [MeasurableSpace X] (K : Set X) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : CausalHistory X X n),
      stateHistoryEquiv n h ∈ historySurvivalSet Kᶜ n ↔
        stateSurvives K n h := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro h
      have h0 (i : Finset.Iic 0) : stateHistoryEquiv 0 h i = h := by
        rw [Subsingleton.elim i (lastHistoryIndex 0)]
        exact stateHistoryEquiv_last 0 h
      constructor
      · intro hs
        have hh := (mem_historySurvivalSet_iff Kᶜ 0 _).mp hs (lastHistoryIndex 0)
        rw [h0] at hh
        change ¬ ¬ (h ∈ K) at hh
        change h ∈ K
        exact not_not.mp hh
      · intro hs
        apply (mem_historySurvivalSet_iff Kᶜ 0 _).mpr
        intro i
        rw [h0 i]
        change ¬ ¬ (h ∈ K)
        change h ∈ K at hs
        exact not_not.mpr hs
  | succ n ih =>
      intro h
      rcases h with ⟨h, x⟩
      rw [stateHistoryEquiv_succ]
      change appendHistory n (stateHistoryEquiv n h, x) ∈
        historySurvivalSet Kᶜ (n + 1) ↔ stateSurvives K n h ∧ x ∈ K
      rw [appendHistory_mem_historySurvivalSet_iff, ih h]
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not]

    {X M Y A : Type u} [Fintype X] [Fintype M]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    [MeasurableSpace M] [MeasurableSingletonClass M]
    (controller : FiniteMemoryController M Y A) (p₀ : PMF X) (q : X → Y)
    (P : ℕ → X → A → PMF X) (n : ℕ) :
    ((microLaw p₀ q P controller.policy n).map
      (stateHistoryEquiv n ∘ eraseActionHistory n)).toMeasure =
      (stateTrajMeasure controller p₀ q P).map (Preorder.frestrictLe n) := by
  rw [stateTrajMeasure, Measure.map_map (Preorder.measurable_frestrictLe n)
    (measurable_mapPath Prod.fst measurable_fst), frestrictLe_mapPath]
  rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_mapHistory Prod.fst measurable_fst n)
    (Preorder.measurable_frestrictLe n), ← actual_augmented_prefix_eq]
  rw [PMF.toMeasure_map, PMF.map_comp]
  · congr 2
    funext h
    change stateHistoryEquiv n (eraseActionHistory n h) =
      mapHistory Prod.fst n (stateHistoryEquiv n (augmentHistory controller q n h))
    rw [← stateHistoryEquiv_map, eraseMemory_augmentHistory]
  · exact measurable_mapHistory Prod.fst measurable_fst n

theorem actual_state_path_eq_stationary_path
    {X Y A : Type u} [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
    (M : Model X (fun _ => A)) (q : X → Y) (sigma : Y → PMF A)
    (p0 : PMF X) (n : ℕ) :
    (causalLaw p0
      (riskMicroControlKernel q (fun _ => M.transitionPMF)
        (observationMarkovPolicy sigma)) n).map (eraseActionHistory n) =
      causalLaw p0 (policyPathKernel M (liftedStationaryPolicy q sigma)) n := by
  let K := riskMicroControlKernel q (fun _ => M.transitionPMF)
    (observationMarkovPolicy sigma)
  let L := policyPathKernel M (liftedStationaryPolicy q sigma)
  change (causalLaw p0 K n).map (eraseActionHistory n) = causalLaw p0 L n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      change p0.map id = p0
      exact PMF.map_id p0
  | succ n ih =>
      have hrow :
          (fun h : CausalHistory X (A × X) n => (K n h).map Prod.snd) =
            (fun h => L n (eraseActionHistory n h)) := by
        funext h
        change
          (riskMicroControlKernel q (fun _ => M.transitionPMF)
            (observationMarkovPolicy sigma) n h).map Prod.snd =
          policyTransitionPMF M (liftedStationaryPolicy q sigma)
            (currentState n (eraseActionHistory n h))
        rw [currentState_eraseActionHistory]
        exact actual_next_state_eq_stationary_row M q sigma n h
      change
        (pmfExtend (causalLaw p0 K n) (K n)).map
            (fun hz => (eraseActionHistory n hz.1, hz.2.2)) =
          pmfExtend (causalLaw p0 L n) (L n)
      calc
        _ = ((pmfExtend (causalLaw p0 K n) (K n)).map
              (fun hz => (hz.1, hz.2.2))).map
              (fun hz => (eraseActionHistory n hz.1, hz.2)) := by
                rw [PMF.map_comp]
                rfl
        _ = (pmfExtend (causalLaw p0 K n)
              (fun h => L n (eraseActionHistory n h))).map
              (fun hz => (eraseActionHistory n hz.1, hz.2)) := by
                rw [risk_map_extend_right, hrow]
        _ = pmfExtend ((causalLaw p0 K n).map (eraseActionHistory n)) (L n) :=
              coverage_map_extend_reference (causalLaw p0 K n)
                (eraseActionHistory n) (L n)
        _ = _ := by rw [ih]
